install_cmds: python -c "import numpy, torch; print('ood-detection-lab runtime ok', 'numpy', numpy.__version__, 'torch', torch.__version__)"

data_deps.name: ood_detection_lab
data_deps.description: Full OpenOOD-style CIFAR-10 OOD protocol, staged entirely offline: uint8 CIFAR-10 train 50000 + test 10000, SVHN test 26032, CIFAR-100 test 10000, Tiny-ImageNet val 10000 resized to 32x32, plus a frozen CIFAR ResNet-18 trained for 100 epochs with the public OpenOOD baseline recipe. Final verification performs real inference over all 106032 images and does not install, download, extract, compile, or train.
